title: AcademicCredentialRecord
description: Standardized schema for historical educational records including diplomas, graduation certificates, commencement programs, and school yearbooks.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Contextual summary (e.g., '1932 High School Diploma of Daniel Lehman (Carlisle High School, Carlisle, PA)').

education_level.description: Educational level token defined under diploma_levels in _token_registry.json.

institution.description: School, academy, college, or university facility. Name is populated in institution.details.location_name.

person_id.description: Foreign key referencing the master Person Registry.

degree_or_credential.description: Stated degree, honors, or credential (e.g., 'High School Diploma', 'Bachelor of Arts', 'Senior Class Roster').

date_issued_or_published.description: Date of graduation, commencement, or yearbook publication.

publication_title.description: Title of the yearbook or program volume (e.g., 'The 1932 Periscope', 'Seventy-Fifth Annual Commencement').

page_or_plate.description: Specific page number, senior portrait plate, or commencement leaflet entry.

credential_note.description: Optional notes on student activities, signatures, inscriptions, or document condition.

transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of certificate or yearbook biography, abstract, and search keywords.

media_files.description: Scans of the diploma, yearbook portrait page, or program leaves.

associated_people.description: Linked participants (student/graduate, school principal, board president, faculty advisor) mapped to roles and IDs.
